title: Admin provenance bundler and residency-aware retention manifest
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an automated service that packages admin-action audit events into tamper-evident evidence bundles that are residency-aware and include a machine-readable retention manifest. These bundles must be verifiable by legal/compliance and consumable for regulator requests. Scope: events for admin actions (role changes, SSO/SAML config updates, RBAC grants/revokes, secret/HSM key rotations, dedicated capacity config changes), plus access attempts and privileged session metadata. Output format: signed bundle (zip/tar.gz) + manifest.json with canonical hashes and custody chain. Storage: object-store with immutable retention flags per-region (object lock/equivalent). Provide API endpoints for scheduled exports, on-demand export requests (with approval workflow), and automated periodic attestations to compliance storage and Slack reporting.
acceptance_criteria: All admin action events in scope are captured and appear in the event stream within 5s of occurrence (99.9% of events)
Evidence bundles are produced with a manifest.json containing canonical SHA256 hashes for every file and a signature created by an HSM-backed key
Bundles are stored to residency-targeted buckets with retention/immutability flags applied and documented in the manifest
Export API can return a signed download and a verification statement for the requested time window
Compliance team can verify signature and hash chain with provided verification tool
Automated proof-of-storage attestation runs nightly and reports success/fail to #compliance-ops with dashboard link
tasks: Instrument admin endpoints to emit structured audit events (schema v2) - ENG changes + tests
Design canonical bundle layout and manifest schema (manifest.json) - include fields: time_range, region, retention_policy_id, objects[], signature_metadata
Integrate signing using KMS/HSM - create key rotation plan and access controls
Implement bundler worker that collects events, builds deterministic archive, computes hashes, signs bundle, and uploads to residency bucket
Add object-store uploader with support for immutable retention lock and lifecycle tagging per-region
Create Export API with RBAC and approval workflow (UI stub for Console team)
Build verification CLI/tool for compliance that validates manifest and signature
Add E2E tests simulating role change, bundle creation, upload, and verification
Document SOP for on-demand regulator exports and retention expiry handling
decisions: Will use SHA256 for canonical hashing across all artifacts (simple, audit-friendly)
Signing performed with HSM-backed KMS key to provide non-exportable private key; metadata includes key fingerprint
Use region-specific object stores (S3 buckets/GCS buckets) and apply provider-native object-lock or retention policies rather than building custom append-only store
Bundle format chosen: tar.gz + detachable manifest.json + signature (.sig) to keep compatibility with verification tools
Redact PII at ingestion where feasible; full raw events kept in sealed evidence only when required by retention policy and legal justification
notes: Trade-offs: enforcing immediate immutable retention (object lock) increases storage costs and complicates emergency deletion. We will implement a documented legal-approval flow for exceptional cases.
We must coordinate with Console team for export UX and with Security to ensure key management policies align with org KMS/HSM standards.
Consider re-using parts of the incident-evidence-store codepath to speed implementation (see related PRs).

Edge case: if region bucket is unavailable at upload time, worker will write to a short-lived escrow queue with metadata and retry policy; escrow retention inherits eventual region residency requirements when transferred.
